test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Obdurate
solution:
The correct answer is '**Amenable**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Obdurate**' is '**Amenable**'.
 
• **Obdurate**: refusing to change your mind to do what people want you to do. (लोगों की इच्छानुसार अपना विचार बदलने से मना करना; हठधर्मी, ज़िद्दी)
 
 
• *Example: He has failed to move with the times because of his **obdurate** attitude.*
 
 
 
• **Amenable**: happy to accept something; willing to be influenced by somebody/something. (ख़ुशी से स्‍वीकार करने वाला; स्‍वेच्‍छा से प्रभावित होने वाला)
 
 
• *Example: I’m **amenable** to any suggestions you may have.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Amenable.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Rigid**: not able to or not wanting to change or be changed. (किसी को बदलने में असमर्थ या परिवर्तित होने का अनिच्‍छुक)
 
• **Callous**: not caring about the feelings or suffering of other people. (दूसरों की भावनाओं या पीड़ा की उपेक्षा करते हुए; कठोर हृदय, बेदर्द, निष्ठुर, संवेदनाहीन)
 
• **Secure**: free from worry or doubt; confident. (संदेह या चिंता से मुक्त; आश्‍वस्‍त, सुरक्षित)
